name: Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) / Gaussian AHP
when_to_use: Multi-criteria decision with pairwise judgments between criteria/alternatives (comparison scale, e.g., Saaty); does not require a continuous statistical variable — it is structured subjective weighting. Gaussian AHP is a variant that dispenses with the traditional consistency check via the consistency ratio (CR).

expected_input.question: How to rank alternatives according to multiple criteria?

pdca_use: Plan phase: prioritize among candidate actions through explicit pairwise judgment by the decision maker (not the library) — deterministic calculation over the supplied weights, useful for the Robot to document why an action was prioritized.

plain_explanation.purpose: Helps choose among options by comparing them two at a time across several criteria.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When the decision involves subjective criteria and needs to be made transparent.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Pairwise comparison scores given by people, between criteria and between options.
plain_explanation.example: Choose among three suppliers by price, lead time and quality.
plain_explanation.diagram: goal -> criteria -> options; summed weights give the final score
